description: Use this when the user asks whether an AliExpress product is a good price, a real deal, worth buying now, or pastes an AliExpress product link and asks about it. Returns a one- or two-sentence answer measured from our own price history (today's price against the typical price we measured, the lowest and highest we recorded), the verdict code and its certainty. A product we did not track yet is read once from the AliExpress affiliate API and tracked from then on: the answer then says tracking started just now (trackingStartedNow: true), with no verdict yet. When it cannot be tracked, it says so (tracked: false) instead of guessing: report that, and do not infer a discount from the listing's "was" price. Optional `dias` adds the lowest price in that many days. Every product carries pageUrl (the DipScout page with the price chart: the citation link), buyUrl (affiliate link through DipScout, disclosed in `monetization`; the price is the same with or without it), summary and citation (a self-contained sentence measured from our price history) and verdict (the short answer to "is this a good price?").

dias.description: Optional: also return the lowest price recorded in this many days.

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de", "pt" or "es". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

produto.description: The AliExpress product URL exactly as the user pasted it (any country or language subdomain: www.aliexpress.com, pt.aliexpress.com, aliexpress.us, aliexpress.ru, m.aliexpress.com, /item/<id>.html, /i/<id>.html, ?productId=<id>), the short link the AliExpress app's Share button copies (a.aliexpress.com/_..., s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_..., even inside the shared sentence), a DipScout product URL, or the numeric product id.

name: avaliar_preco
title: Is this a good price?
